legacy.name: Turó del Corredor
legacy.notes: The best-known rovelló wood in the Maresme, mossy and productive, but you must be on the path by dawn on autumn Sundays.
legacy.access: From Dosrius take the road up to the Corredor sanctuary; park in the small lot by the restaurant at the pass.

legacy.name: Pinedes de Bergús
legacy.notes: Lower and drier; good after wet autumns.
legacy.access: From Solsona take the Bergús road; park at the village and take the south-west track.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Anserall
legacy.notes: Cool north slopes that hold moisture late into October, with moderate weekend pressure from La Seu pickers.
legacy.access: From Anserall take the track up the left bank of the Valira towards Arcavell; park at the bend below the old bridge and follow the path into the north-facing pines.

legacy.name: Obaga del Port del Comte
legacy.notes: Higher belt; best after the mid-October cold rains.
legacy.access: Take the Port del Comte road to the first ski-station bend; park at the lay-by and drop into the north slopes.

legacy.name: Cap del Rec — obaga
legacy.notes: High refuge plateau; late-season producer that keeps fruiting into December.
legacy.access: Forest road from Lles to the Cap del Rec refuge; park at the refuge and take the tracks north of it.

legacy.name: Serra del Montcau — obaga
legacy.notes: The park's high north-west corner; cooler and later than the Mura slopes.
legacy.access: From Talamanca take the road to the Coll d'Estenalles; park at the information centre and follow the Montcau path north.

legacy.name: Obaga de Gerri
legacy.notes: Shady wall above the salt-town; monastery-hamlet start to the morning.
legacy.access: From Gerri cross the bridge and take the forest track on the right; park after the water tank and climb north.

legacy.name: Obaga de Sant Quirc de Durban
legacy.notes: Easy family obaga with a chapel landmark; moderate pressure on Sundays.
legacy.access: From La Pobla take the Durban road to the Sant Quirc chapel; park at the chapel and walk the track behind it.

legacy.name: Boscos de Sant Maurici
legacy.notes: Lower and sunnier, so it fruits early in the season and is largely finished once the obagues higher up start producing.
legacy.access: From La Quar take the local road towards Sant Maurici and continue on the farm track; park at the turning circle by the chapel track.

legacy.name: Mirador de Castellar del Riu
legacy.notes: Popular for the views as much as the mushrooms, so the ring within a kilometre of the car park is picked clean by mid-morning.
legacy.access: From Castellar del Riu take the signed road to the famous viewpoint; park at the mirador car park and take either path down.

legacy.name: Obaga de Gresolet
legacy.notes: Deep obaga on the Gresolet side; later fruiting than the canals and far quieter.
legacy.access: Drive the Saldes-Gresolet road to the hamlet of Gresolet; park at the last houses and take the forest track north.

legacy.name: Boscos del Castell de Mediona
legacy.notes: Deep-soil pine under the castle that holds moisture well into December.
legacy.access: From Mediona take the track signposted to the castle; park at the fold below the castle walls.

legacy.name: Obaga de Feners
legacy.notes: Quiet valley hamlet; the north slopes hold dew until midday.
legacy.access: From Gósol take the road to Feners and park at the village; tracks climb into the north-facing pine belt.

legacy.name: Serra de l'Espunyola
legacy.notes: Quiet, well-mossified Scots pine on the pre-Pyrenean edge that produces steadily in wet autumns with little picking pressure.
legacy.access: From L'Espunyola take the road towards Casserres and turn onto the serra track at the crest; park at the wide bend by the water deposit.

legacy.name: Voltants de Sant Esteve
legacy.notes: Easy family pine around the landmark church that produces modest early crops and is picked over by village children first.
legacy.access: From Perafita take the short road up to the church of Sant Esteve; park in the esplanade by the cemetery and follow any path down.

legacy.name: Obaga de la Vansa
legacy.notes: The valley nobody drives through; dense pine and some of the lowest pressure in the Alt Urgell.
legacy.access: From the La Vansa hamlet follow the valley track toward the Port del Comte side; park at the barrier beyond the last mas.

legacy.name: Pinedes sobre Asland
legacy.notes: South-facing and early; rings first after the September storms.
legacy.access: Park at the old Asland cement works and climb the track above the quarry.

legacy.name: Serra de Banyeres
legacy.notes: Small-town pine that bursts a week after the first storms and is picked out by mid-morning on Sundays.
legacy.access: From Banyeres del Penedès take the track up behind the sports field onto the serra; park at the water depot on the crest.

legacy.name: Obaga Moixa
legacy.notes: Cool dense pine on the valley's shady side that fruits reliably after the first October rains.
legacy.access: From Bassella take the N-260 towards Organyà and turn onto the track for the Obaga Moixa; park at the track barrier.

legacy.name: Riu Calders
legacy.notes: Riverside pine that fruits early after the first rains, a convenient evening spot for Moianès locals and thus quickly picked.
legacy.access: From Calders take the lane towards the river below the village; park at the picnic area by the old bridge.

legacy.name: Serrat de Puitjà
legacy.notes: A north-facing bank above the Ter basin that keeps some humidity, but Girona weekenders work it hard.
legacy.access: From Sant Gregori take the Bescanó road and turn onto the Puitjà track at the quarry bend; park at the flat below the chapel.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Osor
legacy.notes: Deep Guilleries obaga; damp valley granite that holds water all season.
legacy.access: From Osor take the Anglès road 2 km; park at the reservoir track and climb north into the Guilleries.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Espinelves
legacy.notes: Fira de l'Arbreda crowds in November; walk further in than they do.
legacy.access: From Espinelves take the Arbreda road to the last mas; park at the track barrier.

legacy.name: Serrat de Can Pla
legacy.notes: East-facing slopes that dry out fast after rain, so come within two or three days of a good October soaking.
legacy.access: From Arbúcies take the C-63 toward Sant Hilari and turn onto the Can Pla track after the last houses; park at the gate by the pasture.

legacy.name: Obaga de Beget
legacy.notes: Steep quiet obaga above the stone village; very low weekend pressure.
legacy.access: From Camprodon take the Beget road to the last bend above the village; park at the bridge and follow the forest track north.

legacy.name: Serra Sud de Maçanet
legacy.notes: Open mixed pine that gives modest crops most years and is heavily worked on October Sundays.
legacy.access: From Maçanet take the Caldes road and turn onto the serra track at the slaughterhouse bend; park at the water tank.

legacy.name: Costa Llarga de Montagut
legacy.notes: Low warm pine that fruits erratically and is mostly worked by locals on Sundays.
legacy.access: From Montagut take the road towards Oix and park at the track bend above the village; the Costa Llarga path starts there.

legacy.name: Solana de Madremanya
legacy.notes: West-facing groves that fruit early and short, worth the first week after the opening rains.
legacy.access: From Madremanya take the track west past the last houses and follow the contour path; park at the water deposit clearing.

legacy.name: Cova de Marganell
legacy.notes: Busy, dry southern slopes that produce only after abundant rain and are combed daily in season.
legacy.access: From Marganell follow the track south past the hermitage; park at the fountain.

legacy.name: Obaga de Fontmartina
legacy.notes: The west-Montseny Scots belt; the Vallès classic, busy on Sundays.
legacy.access: From Sant Esteve de Palautordera take the Fontmartina track; park at the mas and climb north toward the Turó de l'Home belt.

legacy.name: Santa Bàrbara de Pruneres
legacy.notes: West-facing chapel woods with light pressure and a short but productive season after storms.
legacy.access: From Oix take the track towards the Santa Bàrbara de Pruneres chapel; park below the chapel.

legacy.name: Obaga de Sant Feliu
legacy.notes: Southern gateway to the Garrotxa pines; quiet and family-friendly.
legacy.access: From Sant Feliu de Pallerols take the road toward les Planes; park at the first bridge and follow the track north-east.

legacy.name: Sant Segimon
legacy.notes: Mossy north-face beds that hold their dew well into the morning, though the easy track means crowds sweep them early on autumn Sundays.
legacy.access: From Arbúcies take the Sant Segimon road north past Can Pallot and continue to the end of the forest track; park at the clearing below the shrine.

legacy.name: Costes de Sant Privat
legacy.notes: West rim of the valley; afternoon shade after a morning elsewhere.
legacy.access: From Sant Privat d'en Bas take the track behind the church; park at the bridge.

legacy.name: Costa de Sant Miquel
legacy.notes: Warmer south-west face; earliest fruiting of the zone.
legacy.access: Continue past the castle track to the Sant Miquel fork; park at the col.

legacy.name: Serrat de Vilartolí
legacy.notes: South-facing Albera slopes that bake dry under the north wind and are best in the first mild, humid week of November.
legacy.access: From Espolla take the lane toward Vilartolí and continue on the forest track; park at the bend above the last farmhouse.

legacy.name: Costa de la Vall de Bianya
legacy.notes: Humid valley with a pine-chestnut mix; low pressure on weekdays.
legacy.access: From the Santa Pau-Bianya road park at Els Hostalets and take the track east.

legacy.name: Obaga del castell de Finestres
legacy.notes: Finestres castle slopes; surprise producer after storms.
legacy.access: From Sant Aniol follow the track to the Finestres castle; park below the crag and walk the north path.

legacy.name: Slope above Llanars
legacy.notes: Mossy mixed pine just above the village, popular with Ripollès pickers and often swept by mid-morning.
legacy.access: From Llanars follow the track behind the sports field up the north-east slope; park at the water tank and continue on foot.

legacy.name: Costa de Fontmartina
legacy.notes: Deep Montseny; track access only, worth the walk.
legacy.access: From Montseny village take the Fontmartina road to the farmhouse; park at the track fork.

legacy.name: Obaga de Mieres
legacy.notes: Warm, early zone; check the humid gullies.
legacy.access: From Mieres take the track north past the church; park at the bend.

legacy.name: Obaga de les Salines
legacy.notes: Sanctuary forest on the French border; mixed pine with a damp north face.
legacy.access: From Maçanet take the road to the Salines sanctuary; park at the sanctuary and take the north tracks.

legacy.name: Costa de Bellpuig
legacy.notes: South-east face above the valley floor; dries fast — go right after rain.
legacy.access: From Les Preses follow the Bellpuig signs; park at the hermitage clearing.

legacy.name: Serrat del Pedró d'Anglès
legacy.notes: Proper mossy Scots pine belt that fruits reliably after the first autumn rains and sees only local pickers.
legacy.access: From Anglès take the GI-534 toward Sant Hilari and turn onto the Guilleries track at the Segueró bend; park at the track fork.

legacy.name: Matagalls Ponent
legacy.notes: Western slopes facing Fontmartina see steady traffic, so late arrivals find only scraps.
legacy.access: From Viladrau take the western path up from the Fontmartina side; park where the track forks below the ridge.

legacy.name: Sant Sebastià de Viladrau
legacy.notes: The Montseny classic; very popular — be there at dawn.
legacy.access: From Viladrau take the Sant Sebastià road to the hermitage; park at the spring and walk the north track.

legacy.name: Costa de Sora
legacy.notes: A sunny upper belt that fruits in bursts after cold-front rain, quieter than the cingles and good as an early-season backup.
legacy.access: From Sora take the uphill track towards the eastern pastures; park at the bend by the stone shelter and work the slope below.

legacy.name: Obaga del Ter
legacy.notes: The damp heart of the gorge — long to reach but the mossy Scots pine here holds the best and least-picked rovellons of the sector.
legacy.access: From Sora take the footpath down towards the Ter and follow the shady bank downstream; there is no parking closer than the village fountain.

legacy.name: Cingles de Sora
legacy.notes: Cliff-top pine with sea-of-fog moisture from the gorge, giving strong mid-season flushes but a fair few pickers from Osona.
legacy.access: From Sora take the track along the top of the Ter gorge cliffs; park at the viewpoint clearing and descend the west-facing paths.

legacy.name: Obaga del Bac
legacy.notes: Shady pocket valley between Sant Joan and Ogassa.
legacy.access: Take the road toward el Bac; park at the farm and follow the shady track north.

legacy.name: Sant Corneli de Tavertet
legacy.notes: Clifftop pines over the Ter; drier south faces.
legacy.access: From Tavertet follow the Sant Corneli signs; park at the hermitage and walk the south path.

legacy.name: Sant Miquel de Solterra
legacy.notes: Guilleries high ground with extensive pine tracts.
legacy.access: From Sant Hilari take the Solterra road to the castle ruin; park at the track end.

legacy.name: La Gutina
legacy.notes: Pass forest that catches the morning fog moisture.
legacy.access: Take the road to the La Gutina pass; park at the pass and enter the pines east.

legacy.name: Pinedes del camí de Viladrau
legacy.notes: Woods straddling the Espinelves-Viladrau boundary; deep and shaded.
legacy.access: From Espinelves take the Viladrau track; park at the mas gate and continue on foot.

legacy.name: Obaga de Ciuret
legacy.notes: Border-of-three-comarques forest; dense, quiet, and famously productive.
legacy.access: From Vidrà take the road to Ciuret; park at the hamlet and follow the track north into the pine belt.

legacy.name: Vall d'Osor
legacy.notes: West slopes above the Osor reservoir; humid and green.
legacy.access: From Sant Hilari take the Osor road; park at the reservoir bridge and climb west.

legacy.name: Obaga del camí de Fonollosa
legacy.notes: Low Aleppo stands; early and late-season trickles.
legacy.access: From Sant Fruitós take the Fonollosa road; park at the track fork after 2 km.

legacy.name: Obaga de la Vall de Castellbò
legacy.notes: Border valley, damp and rarely crowded.
legacy.access: From La Seu take the Castellbò road to the village; park at the castle ruin and follow the north track.

legacy.name: Obaga de Meranges
legacy.notes: Border-valley black pine; quiet and cold, later fruiting than the Cerdanya floor.
legacy.access: From Meranges follow the road toward the Engorgs valley; park where it turns to track and walk into the north-east pines.

legacy.name: Pinedes de Surroca
legacy.notes: East-facing terraces warm up early in the season.
legacy.access: From Sant Joan take the Surroca road; park at the old mines and walk east.

legacy.name: Serra de Falset
legacy.notes: Close enough to town for after-work picking, so the first flush after storms disappears within days.
legacy.access: From Falset take the track that climbs the serra behind the cooperative; park at the water tank on the crest.

legacy.name: Obaga de Burgo
legacy.notes: Àneu valley shade; cold nights bring on the flush.
legacy.access: From Esterri take the Burgo road; park at the hamlet and follow the north track.

legacy.name: Solana de Bossòst
legacy.notes: A warm, early slope that gives the first rovellons of the season but bakes dry within days without rain.
legacy.access: From Bossòst take the lane behind the church that zigzags onto the south slope; park where the tarmac ends at the cistern.

legacy.name: Pineda de Les
legacy.notes: Cool pinewood that keeps the dew until mid-morning after the Garona fog lifts, so it fruits early in the season.
legacy.access: From Les take the signed track above the village that climbs the flank north of the N-230; park at the clearing by the water tank at the edge of the pines.

legacy.name: Obaga de Naens
legacy.notes: Bòvida valley pines; zero crowds.
legacy.access: From Senterada take the Naens road to the hamlet; park at the last house and climb north.

legacy.name: Obac de Sant Agustí
legacy.notes: A quiet, elevated obac that holds autumn dampness and fruits well into November.
legacy.access: From Sant Agustí de Lluçanès take the track north past the last masies; park at the water deposit.

legacy.name: Serra de Can Carboner
legacy.notes: Open coastal pine that needs two good rains to produce, then gives a fast, heavily contested flush.
legacy.access: From Tossa take the old Vidreres road and climb the serra track at the second bend; park at the fire-tank clearing.

legacy.name: Serrat de Solius
legacy.notes: A shady north-facing bank inside the Gavarres that fruits well after sea-fog weeks and is a favourite of Aro valley pickers.
legacy.access: From Santa Cristina d'Aro take the road up to Solius past the monastery; park at the fountain above the last houses.

legacy.name: Bacs de Casses
legacy.notes: West-facing bacs close to La Bisbal, so expect company from mid-morning onwards on holidays.
legacy.access: From Corçà take the road toward La Bisbal and turn onto the forest track at the Kilometre 2 marker; park at the track widening.

legacy.name: Serra Nord de Corçà
legacy.notes: North-east slopes that catch the sea damp and give reliable early crops in most autumns.
legacy.access: From Corçà take the track up from the Rupià road toward the Gavarres; park at the bend by the water deposit.

legacy.name: Costes de Romanyà
legacy.notes: Mossy northwest slopes above the valley that hold the dew, but Romanyà's fame brings heavy weekend pressure.
legacy.access: From Calonge take the Vall de Calonge road north and turn off at the Romanyà signs; park at the Gavarres track gate past the hamlet.

legacy.name: Solà de Tírvia
legacy.notes: An easy family slope near the village that takes heavy weekend pressure once the season opens.
legacy.access: From Tírvia take the road up to the mirador above the village; park at the viewpoint and drop onto the sunny benches.

legacy.name: Obaga de Peramola
legacy.notes: Dissected terrain with very low picker pressure.
legacy.access: From Peramola take the track toward Tragó; park at the pass and walk west.

legacy.name: Serra de Mermider
legacy.notes: Ordinary pine belt that yields modest baskets after sustained autumn rain.
legacy.access: From Les Llosses take the track along the Serra de Mermider; park at the col by the transmitter.

legacy.name: Serrat de Terrades
legacy.notes: Open pine with light crops in dry years, best visited mid-week when pressure is low.
legacy.access: From Ripoll take the track towards the Serrat de Terrades; park at the quarry bend.

legacy.name: Vall de la Conca
legacy.notes: A sheltered valley side that keeps producing after the windier crests have dried out.
legacy.access: From Barberà de la Conca take the lane towards Montblanc and turn onto the eastern valley track; park at the bridge.

legacy.name: Pinedes de la Pena
legacy.notes: West flank above the Pena stream; mid-level pressure.
legacy.access: Take the la Pena turn from the main road; park at the village and walk west.

legacy.name: Obaga de Prats de Lluçanès
legacy.notes: Lluçanès plateau woods; quiet, central and overlooked.
legacy.access: From Prats de Lluçanès take the track behind the church; park at the sports field and walk north-west.

legacy.name: Costa de Nas
legacy.notes: Overlooked western flank toward the Segre gorge.
legacy.access: From Bellver take the Nas road to the hamlet; park at the church and walk west.

legacy.name: Costa de la Torre
legacy.notes: A quiet southeastern flank of Montnegre that produces reliably but only rewards those willing to walk the full hour in.
legacy.access: From Sant Celoni take the Olzinelles road and branch left at the Torre track; park at the track end by the stream.

legacy.name: Riera d'Olvan
legacy.notes: Low, open pine along the stream that fruits only after very wet Octobers and is picked over within days.
legacy.access: From Olvan take the C-16 frontage road down to the riera bridge; park at the wide verge before the track.

legacy.name: Serrat de la Bauma
legacy.notes: South face; only after a wet week, then surprisingly good.
legacy.access: From the western exit of the village take the serra track; park at the bend.

legacy.name: Coll de Collsuspina
legacy.notes: Shady pass forests; good moisture retention.
legacy.access: Park at the pass on the C-59; the tracks drop north into the shade.

legacy.name: Serra de Bestracà
legacy.notes: Open Mediterranean-facing pine that needs heavy September rain before it produces at all.
legacy.access: From Albanyà take the track towards the Serra de Bestracà; park at the Coll de Bestracà.

legacy.name: Vall Major north slopes
legacy.notes: Ordinary Scots pine close to La Seu so it gets picked early on October weekends.
legacy.access: From the road towards Castellbò park at the mirador bend above the valley; take the footpath into the pines on the north side.

legacy.name: Sant Pere de Gallifa
legacy.notes: Small-village forest tracks; moderate pressure.
legacy.access: From Gallifa follow the Sant Pere signs; park at the church and take the north path.

legacy.name: Cingles de Sau
legacy.notes: Damp cliff-country pine above the pantà, scenic and busy, with good post-rain flushes.
legacy.access: From Vilanova de Sau take the road past the reservoir dam and climb to the cliff footpaths; park at the mirador.

legacy.name: Puig de l'Alarma
legacy.notes: The first serious climb above the plain holds damp north faces that fruit well after sea-fog nights.
legacy.access: From Vall-llobrega take the track behind the village toward the Gavarres ridge; park at the firing-range gate.

legacy.name: Serrat d'Usall
legacy.notes: A west-facing serrat that catches the afternoon sun, giving good early-season flushes when late September is wet.
legacy.access: From Banyoles take the GI-513 toward Usall and park at the bend where the tarmac becomes a forest track.

legacy.name: Obaga del Freser
legacy.notes: High valley of the Freser; peaks around late October.
legacy.access: From Queralbs follow the Núria road to the first tunnel; park at the lay-by and take the west path.

legacy.name: Coves del Tambor
legacy.notes: Easy-access pine that gets swept quickly, so it is only worth a dawn stop on the first damp morning after rain.
legacy.access: From Capellades take the road towards the Coves del Tambor park; park at the picnic area car park by the caves.

legacy.name: Vall d'Àssua
legacy.notes: Quiet side valley; terraced pines above the fields.
legacy.access: From Sort cross to the Vall d'Àssua road; park at Altron and take the south-east track.

legacy.name: Coll de Jou
legacy.notes: Drier south-east slopes that fruit only after good autumn rain and see little picking pressure.
legacy.access: From Alinyà take the track past the Casa Forestal towards the Coll de Jou; park at the clearing on the col.

legacy.name: Costa de Josa
legacy.notes: A rich mixed pine belt with thick moss where rovellons fruit in flushes from late September.
legacy.access: From Josa take the old path towards the Costa de Josa; park at the track gate below the village.

legacy.name: Els Plans d'Oló
legacy.notes: Sunny plateau pine that needs repeated rains before the first rovellons show.
legacy.access: From Santa Maria d'Oló follow the lane south-east onto the plans; park at the grain store.

legacy.name: El Solei d'Osormort
legacy.notes: Ordinary southern pine, productive only in wet autumns and picked by locals daily.
legacy.access: From Sant Sadurní d'Osormort follow the lane south past the church; park at the bridge over the riera.

legacy.name: Obaga de Moià
legacy.notes: Central Moianès plateau; quick from Barcelona but picked early.
legacy.access: From Moià take the Granera road; park at the first track heading north.

legacy.name: North slopes above Àreu
legacy.notes: Rich mixed pine belt in the heart of Vall Ferrera, among the best-producing slopes in the Pallars.
legacy.access: From Alins follow the road up to Àreu and take the forest track climbing the shaded side of the valley; park at the sawmill clearing.

legacy.name: Coma dels Rasos
legacy.notes: East-facing bowl that thaws first; good early-season producer.
legacy.access: From the ski station take the eastward cross-country track; park where it forks at the first clearing.

legacy.name: Castell de Sentmenat
legacy.notes: Easy access means these dry open pines are swept early; useful only on the first morning after good rain.
legacy.access: From Sentmenat take the lane up to the Castell de Sentmenat; park at the track gate below the tower.

legacy.name: Serrat de Can Boquet
legacy.notes: A warm south face that closes early in dry years, worth only on the first cool, wet week of October.
legacy.access: From Dosrius take the Canyamars road and turn left onto the Can Boquet track; park at the bend by the water tank.

legacy.name: Costa de Sant Miquel del Pui
legacy.notes: Sunny confluence of the Flamisell and Segre; early ring.
legacy.access: Take the road up to Sant Miquel del Pui; park at the chapel.

legacy.name: Pinedes del Salí
legacy.notes: Pines over the salt valley; the fast-draining soil needs solid rain first.
legacy.access: From the Cardona salt-mountain road park at the Salí gate; tracks run west.

legacy.name: Obaga de Capafonts
legacy.notes: Prades' quieter eastern flank; good dew catch.
legacy.access: From Capafonts take the track behind the last houses; park at the spring.

legacy.name: Camí de Mont-ral
legacy.notes: East slopes over the Brugent gorge; humid air climbs from the stream.
legacy.access: Take the Mont-ral track; park at the pass above the Brugent gorge.

legacy.name: Turó de la Creu d'Ardaca
legacy.notes: Corredor foothills that open the Maresme season early and draw Barcelona pickers each Sunday.
legacy.access: From Òrrius take the BV-5005 toward Vilanova del Vallès and turn onto the turó track; park at the crossroads clearing.

legacy.name: Pla de Palau
legacy.notes: Dry Garraf Aleppo that only produces after a stormy autumn, when the shaded north hollows fill quickly.
legacy.access: From Olivella take the road towards Sitges and turn off at the Pla de Palau track; park at the fire tank by the track junction.

legacy.name: Serra d'Ordal
legacy.notes: The Ordal range is the metro's favourite mushroom hill; expect company from dawn and a picked-clean understory by noon.
legacy.access: From Corbera de Llobregat take the forest track towards the Serra d'Ordal; park at the spring below the pass.

legacy.name: Vessant est d'Arnes
legacy.notes: Morning-sun sector; go right after the first autumn storm.
legacy.access: From the village take the east track past the olive mill; park at the bend.

legacy.name: Els Estrets
legacy.notes: Cool gorge heads near the Ports fringe give one of the earliest and most dependable rovellón runs in the Terra Alta.
legacy.access: From Prat de Comte take the track towards the Estrets gorge; park at the barrier by the abandoned terraces.

legacy.name: Serrat de les Farges
legacy.notes: Weekend pressure from the Bages belt means early mornings pay off after rain.
legacy.access: From Sallent take the C-16 service road towards the Llobregat and climb the track at the Serrat de les Farges; park at the water tank.

legacy.name: Serra de Caseres
legacy.notes: West-facing pines dry fast so time your visit right after September storm fronts pass through.
legacy.access: From Caseres take the track that rises west along the serra towards the Aragón border; park at the clearing on the crest.

legacy.name: Sant Elies
legacy.notes: Montseny's south-west flank keeps good humidity here, but the Granollers weekend tide reaches even these paths.
legacy.access: From Cànoves take the road up towards Sant Elies; park at the chapel and follow the forest track north-east.

legacy.name: Obaga Major
legacy.notes: Deep mossy Scots pine that keeps moisture well, though the climb keeps casual pickers away and pressure stays moderate.
legacy.access: From La Quar take the track that climbs behind the church towards the upper pastures; park at the gate where the tarmac ends.

legacy.name: Obaga dels Ports
legacy.notes: Els Ports north faces; rovellons with mountain sage.
legacy.access: From Horta take the road toward Els Ports; park at the barrier before the park boundary and climb north.

legacy.name: Turó de la Corona
legacy.notes: West-facing slopes drain fast, so pick here only in the days right after rain while the shaded hollows are still damp.
legacy.access: From Òdena take the track up towards the Turó de la Corona behind the industrial estate; park at the wide shoulder where the pines start.

legacy.name: Vall d'Horta
legacy.notes: Sheltered valley; locals start here at first light.
legacy.access: Take the Horta valley road; park at the casal and follow the track east.

legacy.name: Coma Fosca
legacy.notes: Shaded gullies that keep moisture through dry spells; the rovellons arrive later but fatter than on the solana.
legacy.access: From Poboleda take the trail signed to the Montsant springs and leave the path at the second gully; park at the edge of the village.

legacy.name: Serra del Gaià
legacy.notes: A good upper-Gaià pine belt that keeps fruiting through November in wet years.
legacy.access: From Sant Martí Sarroca take the road towards Pontons and turn right onto the track above the vineyards; park at the clearing at the top of the bend.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Alsamora
legacy.notes: Terraced-world hamlet above the Mont-rebei gorge; quiet and damp.
legacy.access: From Alsamora hamlet take the track north-west; park at the last house and climb the hollow.

legacy.name: Solà de Gavet
legacy.notes: Thin, open cover that dries quickly — an early-season option while the higher zones are still parched.
legacy.access: From Gavet take the track behind the village church onto the sunny ridge; park where the track narrows at the pines.

legacy.name: Serra de la Torre
legacy.notes: Dry south-west faces need storm rain, but when it comes the rovellons appear in tight rings and go fast.
legacy.access: From Riba-roja d'Ebre take the track that climbs the serra north-west; park at the bend below the tower ruin.

legacy.name: Castell de Miralles
legacy.notes: Dense north-facing pine around the castle keeps its humidity, and the distance from town keeps weekend pressure moderate.
legacy.access: From Sant Llorenç d'Hortons take the track towards the Castell de Miralles; park at the plateau below the ruins.

legacy.name: Els Bacives
legacy.notes: Resort-side black pine with steady weekend pressure; the far side of the ridge is quieter and fruits later.
legacy.access: From Setcases take the mountain road up to the Vallter 2000 resort; park at the base station and walk the slopes below the Bacives ridge.

legacy.name: Pòrt de Caldes
legacy.notes: Cold, late ground where rovellons flush from mid-October, and the long walk-in keeps pressure minimal.
legacy.access: From Era Artiga de Lin follow the Colomèrs trail up the Valarties to the Pòrt de Caldes springs; there is no vehicle access beyond the Artiga.

legacy.name: Serrat del Prat de Cadí
legacy.notes: Very quiet high black pine where fruiting waits for late October and the first snows can cut the season short.
legacy.access: From Montellà take the Cadí footpath to the serrat above the Prat; park at the same gate and continue past the plateau.

legacy.name: Serrat del Molló
legacy.notes: Ordinary pine stands that only fruit well after steady September rain, with light local picking pressure.
legacy.access: From Peralada take the GIV-602 toward Vilabertran and turn onto the serrat track; park at the gate below the ridge.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Organyà
legacy.notes: Peramola range pines; needs a wet autumn to deliver.
legacy.access: From Organyà take the road toward Fígols; park at the first hairpin and climb north.

legacy.name: Obaga de Pruit
legacy.notes: Rupit itself is picked over; the Pruit side is quieter.
legacy.access: From Rupit take the Pruit road to the hamlet; park at the church and follow the track north-west.

legacy.name: Solana d'Alins
legacy.notes: Warmer bank that starts producing before the high slopes, worth checking in late September.
legacy.access: From Alins take the track that rises behind the church towards the sunny slope; park at the fountain at the edge of the wood.

legacy.name: Turó de les Closes
legacy.notes: Dry south-facing Aleppo pine that only fruits after heavy autumn storms, so it is a quick-stop spot rather than a guarantee.
legacy.access: From Vidreres take the road toward Llagostera and park at the wide bend by the Mas Ros track.

legacy.name: Canalda
legacy.notes: The famous Canalda woods; big rings but expect company.
legacy.access: From La Coma take the road to Canalda; park at the sanctuary and walk into the pines.

legacy.name: Obaga de Mura
legacy.notes: Stream-side Aleppo belt; fruits after any decent September storm.
legacy.access: From Mura's plaça take the cement track north; park at the bend by the stream and climb into the pines.

legacy.name: Pla de les Arenes
legacy.notes: Easy parking makes the Pla a magnet for families, so the near pines are bare while the far banks still produce.
legacy.access: From Llinars del Vallès take the BV-5101 to the Pla de les Arenes; park at the picnic area and take the north-east trail.

legacy.name: Serra de Llaberia sud
legacy.notes: Cool dense pinewood that holds moisture from the first storms; expect a long walk and almost no other pickers midweek.
legacy.access: From Tivissa take the road toward Pradell de la Teixeta and park where the track to the antennas leaves the pass; follow the path into the pines.

legacy.name: Obaga nord de Campdevànol
legacy.notes: Continuous pine north of town; holds moisture well.
legacy.access: From town take the forest track opposite the campsite; park at the gate after 1 km.

legacy.name: Costa de la Figuera
legacy.notes: South rim above the Ebro; earliest of the Montsant sectors.
legacy.access: From La Figuera take the track toward the Montsant cliff; park at the vineyard shed.

legacy.name: Serra de Busa
legacy.notes: Cliff-top plateau; the damp hollows produce after light rains.
legacy.access: From Sant Llorenç de Morunys take the Busa road to the Hostal de Busa; park at the chapel and walk the serra.

legacy.name: Costes de Santa Maria de Meià
legacy.notes: Karstic, fast-draining ground that flushes briefly but heavily after the autumn storms.
legacy.access: From Vilanova de Meià take the road towards Santa Maria de Meià; park at the old canonical house and climb onto the south-east slopes.

legacy.name: Comes Altes
legacy.notes: Open stands that dry quickly, productive only when the tramuntana lets the autumn rains settle in.
legacy.access: From Celrà take the GI-632 toward Juià and turn onto the track at the quarry bend; park at the quarry apron.

legacy.name: Siurana Slopes
legacy.notes: Popular weekend country under Siurana's cliffs, so go on a weekday if you want the shady north benches.
legacy.access: From Cornudella de Montsant take the road up to Siurana; park at the reservoir dam and climb the north track.

legacy.name: Serra de Mentid
legacy.notes: Local families work these slopes hard at weekends, so an early start matters in wet years.
legacy.access: From Tuixén take the forest track along the Serra de Mentid; park at the col above the village.

legacy.name: Capsacosta pass
legacy.notes: High damp pass pine with quality moss, slow to fruit but lasting into November and barely picked.
legacy.access: From Hostalnou continue towards Sant Salvador de Bianya and park where the track forks; follow the old path up to the Capsacosta pass and into the north-facing pine.

legacy.name: Obaga de Montellà
legacy.notes: First Cadí north faces above the Cerdanya floor; mixes Scots and black pine as it climbs.
legacy.access: From Montellà take the track toward the Cadí; park at the last mas and climb north.

legacy.name: Mirador de Cerc
legacy.notes: Ordinary pine on stony ground, worth a visit only when the lower woods have already dried out.
legacy.access: From Cerc take the BV-4241 north and pull in above the reservoir; park at the viewpoint lay-by.

legacy.name: Pinedes d'Albarca
legacy.notes: North-west benches near the abandoned village; strong habitat, low pressure.
legacy.access: From the Prades-Albarca road park at the hamlet; tracks climb north-west.

legacy.name: Obaga de Catllaràs
legacy.notes: The classic Catllaràs obaga holds humidity long after rain but is a fixture on weekend Berga circuits — go at first light.
legacy.access: From Vilada take the BV-4031 towards La Pobla de Lillet and then the Catllaràs track on the right; park at the old fountain bend.

legacy.name: Solana de Llavorsí
legacy.notes: Handy to town so it gets picked over early — best in the first days after an autumn storm.
legacy.access: From Llavorsí cross the bridge towards the Sort road and take the first forest track on the left; park at the bend and climb the sunny side.

legacy.name: Obaga de Montnegre
legacy.notes: Aleppo-pine rovellons 40 minutes from the coast; busy on Maresme Sundays.
legacy.access: From Fogars de Montclús take the road over the Montnegre ridge; park at the track junction below the summit and drop into the north slopes toward Tordera.

legacy.name: Vall d'Unarre
legacy.notes: A quiet, humid corner with little traffic and mossy beds that produce through October.
legacy.access: From Escaló take the rough lane up the val d'Unarre; park at the first gate and continue on foot along the east flank.

legacy.name: Costa de Tuixén
legacy.notes: West-facing benches above Tuixén; the afternoon-warm option of the valley.
legacy.access: From Tuixén take the Josa road out of the village; park at the first bend and climb west.

legacy.name: Farena
legacy.notes: The warm Brugent valley side starts early and the hamlet regulars pick it hard on free mornings.
legacy.access: From Mont-ral take the road down to the Farena hamlet; park by the bridge and climb the southern track.

legacy.name: Obaga de Lles
legacy.notes: Cerdanya's easy high obaga; popular with Andorra day-trippers, go early.
legacy.access: From Lles take the forest road toward Aransa; park at the first bend and walk into the north belt.

legacy.name: Costa de Gallifa
legacy.notes: Sunny side; pairs with the obaga as an early/late option.
legacy.access: From the pass road take the south track; park at the farm gate.

legacy.name: La Albarca
legacy.notes: Transition woodland between Montsant and Prades that gives steady rovellons after the first cold rains.
legacy.access: From Cornudella de Montsant take the road towards La Albarca; park at the hamlet and follow the forest track east.

legacy.name: Obac d'Osormort
legacy.notes: Mossy Guilleries-edge pine that produces well and still escapes the worst crowds.
legacy.access: From Sant Sadurní d'Osormort take the C-25 side road and turn onto the forest track; park at the col.

legacy.name: El Tagamanent
legacy.notes: Montseny southern gateway; quiet on weekdays.
legacy.access: From Tagamanent village take the hill road; park below the church on the summit.

legacy.name: Slope above Arròs de Cardós
legacy.notes: Dense shade keeps the moss wet, and the short steep climb filters out weekend pressure.
legacy.access: From Esterri de Cardós drive down to Arròs de Cardós and take the steep track on the valley side; park at the transformer station.

legacy.name: Serrat d'Oristà
legacy.notes: A cool ridge shoulder where late-season rovellons linger after the lower woods finish.
legacy.access: From Oristà take the lane north-east to the serrat above the village; park where the tarmac ends.

legacy.name: Coll de Pal — obaga del Cadí
legacy.notes: High belt that switches on after the first cold nights; easy roadside access.
legacy.access: Park at the Coll de Pal pass; the black-pine belt spreads below the road on the Cadí side.

legacy.name: Serra de Padro (oest)
legacy.notes: Long west flank with almost no competition on weekdays.
legacy.access: Take the track west of Gósol toward the Padro ridge; park where the track forks at the coll.

legacy.name: Tossal de la Baltasana
legacy.notes: Top rovelló fame — and crowds; walk the north drop from the summit.
legacy.access: From Prades take the track to the tossal; park at the track end below the summit.

legacy.name: Costa Solana
legacy.notes: Warm open slope that only produces after generous rain, with very light picking pressure.
legacy.access: From Cava take the road towards Ansovell and turn onto the Costa Solana track; park at the shrine bend.

legacy.name: Llevant de Cavalls
legacy.notes: Open eastern slope that needs a proper storm to get going; late October and November give the best windows.
legacy.access: From Tivissa take the road toward Darmós and turn onto the olive-grove track at the second bend; park at the pond by the ruined mas.

legacy.name: Costa de Tragó
legacy.notes: East terraces over the Segre; almost unknown to pickers.
legacy.access: Continue on the Tragó road to the abandoned village; park below it.

legacy.name: Turó del Castell
legacy.notes: High Vallès pine that starts late and lasts long, though the village's own pickers work the near banks weekly.
legacy.access: From Sant Feliu de Codines take the lane up to the castle hill; park at the fence at the top of the paved section.

legacy.name: Obaga de Salàs
legacy.notes: Overlooked woods above the reservoir.
legacy.access: From Salàs follow the reservoir road; park at the second bend and climb west.

legacy.name: Vessant est de Planoles
legacy.notes: East slopes with continuous canopy toward the Tossa zone.
legacy.access: Take the farm track opposite the N-260 bend; park at the barn.

legacy.name: El Solei del Grau
legacy.notes: Warmer slopes that fruit briefly after storms and see mostly local traffic.
legacy.access: From Sant Bartomeu del Grau follow the lane south-east down the valley; park at the old mill.

legacy.name: Serrat de Mata
legacy.notes: North-facing woods that trap the sea moisture and a Barcelona train-and-boot classic, so expect many baskets on Sundays.
legacy.access: From Arenys de Munt take the lane up past El Rieral and continue on the forest track toward Mata; park at the clearing by the old spring.

legacy.name: Serra d'Aguir
legacy.notes: Open pine near the transmission masts where yields are modest and the Maresme crowds pass through anyway.
legacy.access: From Cabrera de Mar take the road toward Vilassar de Dalt and turn onto the serra track; park at the water deposit.

legacy.name: Costa de Baén
legacy.notes: Quiet corner of the Baix Pallars with light picking pressure and steady crops in moist years.
legacy.access: From Peramea follow the lane towards Baén and continue on the track above the hamlet; park at the bridge before the track climbs.

legacy.name: Carena de la Serralada de Marina
legacy.notes: The most pressured woodland in the Maresme, with Barcelona pickers out before sunrise after every rain.
legacy.access: From Teià take the BV-5002 up to the Coll de Can Borrell and park at the coll; walk the carena north of the road.

legacy.name: Obaga de la Vall de Lord
legacy.notes: Shaded slopes above the reservoir; afternoon shade holds humidity.
legacy.access: From Guixers take the old road along the reservoir; park at the second viaduct and climb north.

legacy.name: Serrat de Bell-lloc
legacy.notes: A south-facing crest above the coast that dries fast, so time it right after rain or miss it.
legacy.access: From Santa Cristina d'Aro take the Bell-lloc lane west out of town; park at the track gate by the water tank.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Erill la Vall
legacy.notes: Damp and steady — it arrives about a week before the higher beds and holds on with the autumn mists.
legacy.access: From Barruera take the road to Erill la Vall; park by the church and take the track onto the shady side above the campsite.

legacy.name: Costa de la Tor
legacy.notes: Village-side slope picked by families after school hours, so morning visits find the best flushes.
legacy.access: From La Tor de Cerdanya take the forest track towards the Bosc de la Coma; park at the fountain above the village.

legacy.name: Pinedes de Serrateix
legacy.notes: Monastery woods; moderate pressure and a nice pine-oak mix.
legacy.access: From Cardona take the Serrateix road; park at the monastery and walk south-east.

legacy.name: Muntanyes de Prades
legacy.notes: Dense high Scots pine above Arbolí holds moisture all autumn but the walk keeps all but serious pickers away.
legacy.access: From Arbolí take the track that climbs into the Prades massif; park at the barrier at the upper forest edge.

legacy.name: Serrat de Riells
legacy.notes: A quiet serrat of mixed pine that holds dew and is a reliable fallback when the Fai paths are picked clean.
legacy.access: From Riells del Fai take the lane up past the church and continue on the forest track onto the serrat; park at the track end.

legacy.name: Llaberia North
legacy.notes: The shady side of Llaberia holds dew late and rovellons appear after storm fronts roll in off the sea.
legacy.access: From Pratdip take the track that climbs north into the Llaberia range; park at the fold below the north face.

legacy.name: Serrat de les Fonts
legacy.notes: Moderate groves near the springs that keep damp and get picked in waves all through October.
legacy.access: From Òrrius take the track from behind the church toward the south-east serrat; park at the fountain on the lower path.

legacy.name: Serra de la Llena nord
legacy.notes: Dense Scots pine on the shaded side of la Llena; the classic rovelló bank of les Garrigues, busy the weekend after any storm.
legacy.access: From Vinaixa take the road towards Arbeca that climbs la Llena; park at the pass and follow the crest track north.

legacy.name: Serra Grossa
legacy.notes: Open southern pines that need a wet autumn to produce, and even then the best banks are bare by ten o'clock.
legacy.access: From La Pobla take the lane towards Serra Grossa past the vineyards and follow the fire break track; park at the cistern.

legacy.name: Puigllançada — serrat est
legacy.notes: East spur of Puigllançada; dries out sooner — start the season here.
legacy.access: From the Coll de Pal road take the first forest track east; park at the bend and follow the serrat crest.

legacy.name: Puigllançada — obaga major
legacy.notes: Big black-pine bowl between Bagà and La Pobla; rings well into November.
legacy.access: From the Coll de Pal road park at the Puigllançada signpost; climb the track into the north slopes below the summit.

legacy.name: Coll de la Llosa
legacy.notes: High, damp corner of the serra where the season starts early and lasts; worth the winding drive after August storms.
legacy.access: From Vinaixa follow the la Llena road to the Coll de la Llosa and take the westward track; park at the coll.

legacy.name: Costes de Puig Figuer
legacy.notes: Sunny coastal slopes with easy parking, so anything within sight of the road is gone by ten in the morning.
legacy.access: From Tossa take the Sant Grau road and stop at the bend below Puig Figuer; park at the picnic-area lay-by.

legacy.name: Serrat Alt
legacy.notes: The highest and dampest pine around Valls: north banks here keep producing after the lower country has dried out.
legacy.access: From Valls take the road towards Nulles and turn onto the Serrat Alt forest track; park at the fire break gate.

legacy.name: Serra de la Vilella
legacy.notes: North-east slopes catch the morning dew and give a steady second flush when other Priorat zones dry out.
legacy.access: From La Vilella Alta take the track that climbs north-east above the village; park at the pine edge by the cistern.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Espot
legacy.notes: Stay outside the Aigüestortes boundary — collecting inside the national park is not allowed.
legacy.access: From Espot take the Sant Maurici road to the first hairpin; park at the lay-by and take the north track away from the park boundary.

legacy.name: Serra d'Ordal nord
legacy.notes: The best-drained north slopes around Begues hold a late November crop, but expect company from the Baix Llobregat.
legacy.access: From Begues take the road towards Sant Llorenç d'Ordal and turn off on the forest track after the second rise; park at the clearing by the pylon.

legacy.name: Tossal Gros
legacy.notes: A narrow Aleppo belt that wakes with the first October storms and is worked quickly by locals — go within days of good rain.
legacy.access: From Ascó take the track behind the sports centre towards the tossals and follow the fire road up; park at the clearing below the transmitter mast.

legacy.name: Sant Marc
legacy.notes: Open Aleppo slopes near the hermitage fruit only after wet storms, but the walk is short and pleasant.
legacy.access: From Pratdip take the lane up to the Sant Marc hermitage; park at the hermitage and walk the crest.

legacy.name: Costes de Sant Silvestre
legacy.notes: Sheltered slopes above the reservoir that keep moisture from the Segre valley mists and are picked by locals at weekends.
legacy.access: From Oliana take the C-14 south and climb the track signed for Sant Silvestre; park at the hermitage gate.

legacy.name: Turó dels Camps
legacy.notes: Open groves with light yields but almost no competition on weekday mornings.
legacy.access: From Sils take the track west from the station quarter and climb the turó; park at the bend by the antenna.

legacy.name: Pinedes de Castelladral
legacy.notes: The best-known pine slope above Súria, early and productive after September storms but worked over by local families at weekends.
legacy.access: From Súria take the BV-3001 towards Castelladral and turn onto the forest track at the hillside bend; park at the clearing by the shrine.

legacy.name: Obaga de Montsor
legacy.notes: Shady flank over the Segre; mid-season sweet spot.
legacy.access: From La Pobla cross the Segre to Montsor; park at the village and take the west track.

legacy.name: Obaga dels Rasos de Peguera
legacy.notes: Berga's backyard: road-accessible high obaga, so expect pickers — go on a weekday morning.
legacy.access: From Berga take the Rasos de Peguera road to the ski station; park at the station and walk straight into the north slopes.

legacy.name: Serra de Galliners
legacy.notes: A modest but little-visited belt above the Llobregat that keeps moisture on its north face and surprises in consistently rainy autumns.
legacy.access: From Puig-reig take the BV-4235 towards Montmajor and pull onto the forest track at the Galliners sign; park at the junction by the transformer hut.

legacy.name: Turó de la Bisbal
legacy.notes: A small north-facing wood that stays productive a few days longer than the surrounding dry slopes.
legacy.access: From La Bisbal del Penedès take the lane up the Turó behind the village; park at the track barrier at the pine edge.

legacy.name: Serrat de les Soleies
legacy.notes: Sun-baked open pine that needs a wet September before it produces, then goes fast under pressure from town.
legacy.access: From Oliana cross the Segre bridge and take the track up the Serrat de les Soleies; park at the first bend.

legacy.name: Obaga de Planoles
legacy.notes: Cool and shaded; good in mild Novembers.
legacy.access: From Planoles take the forest road north of the village; park at the water deposit and walk in.

legacy.name: Obaga de Sant Gervàs
legacy.notes: Close to Tremp, so it bears the town's weekend pickers — be there at first light in October.
legacy.access: From Tremp take the road towards Puigcercós and continue to the north flank of the serra; park at the water tank and enter the woods.

legacy.name: Feixes del Montsec
legacy.notes: Town-adjacent ground under steady local pressure — pick it in the first days after rain.
legacy.access: From Os de Balaguer take the track that climbs behind the village towards the Montsec foot; park at the first bench of terraces.

legacy.name: Voltants de Corçà
legacy.notes: Wind-exposed open stand where crops appear briefly after the first autumn storms.
legacy.access: From Àger take the road to Corçà and continue on the forest track towards the crest; park at the bend at the upper meadows.

legacy.name: Baga de Maçaners
legacy.notes: Classic shady slope between Bagà and the Cadí; reliable mid-season.
legacy.access: From Bagà take the Maçaners road to the hamlet; park at the chapel and follow the track into the baga.

legacy.name: Pinedes de la Riera
legacy.notes: Shadier and slightly damper than the crest, so it fruits after smaller rains than the rest of the range.
legacy.access: From Begues follow the lane up the riera past the last houses; park at the picnic clearing where the track forks.

legacy.name: Obac de la Molsosa
legacy.notes: A remote, damp obac where baskets fill slowly but surely and you rarely meet another picker.
legacy.access: From La Molsosa take the lane north-west past the last mas; park at the end of the tarmac.

legacy.name: Serra d'Avellanida east
legacy.notes: Well-trodden serra pine with reliable moss, among the first Cerdanya spots to fruit and correspondingly picked.
legacy.access: From the N-260 between Puigcerdà and Bolvir take the forest track onto the serra; park at the water deposit and walk east along the crest.

legacy.name: Coll de Mollerussa
legacy.notes: The Prades road brings weekend pickers, so the north benches go fast after every storm.
legacy.access: From Alforja take the road towards Prades to the Coll de Mollerussa; park at the col and follow the north track.

legacy.name: East slope of Sanaüja
legacy.notes: Quiet east-facing stand where scots pine mixes in and the crop stretches later than on the plain.
legacy.access: From Sanaüja take the lane east towards Biosca and turn onto the pine track; park at the barns at the track bend.

legacy.name: Pinedes de Capmany
legacy.notes: Wine-village pines; the tramuntana dries them fast, go right after rain.
legacy.access: From Capmany take the Requesens track 3 km; park at the fold and climb the north-east slopes.

legacy.name: Serra de Gratallops
legacy.notes: North faces above the Priorat vineyards fruit well after storms, and wine-country visitors keep pressure modest.
legacy.access: From Gratallops take the track that rises north above the vineyards; park at the pine belt where the track ends.

legacy.name: Camí de Norís
legacy.notes: High open stand that only wakes after sustained September rain, but then holds moisture through cold snaps.
legacy.access: From Àreu take the rough lane signed to Norís; park at the village and follow the path into the open black pine stands above.

legacy.name: Solà del Ter
legacy.notes: Moderate cover on the Guilleries fringe where the season stretches into December in wet years.
legacy.access: From Anglès take the track along the Ter toward the falls and climb at the marked path; park at the angling club car park.

legacy.name: Costa d'Escaladei
legacy.notes: Shaded terraces of the Priorat; a vineyard-pine mosaic.
legacy.access: From La Morera continue to Escaladei; park at the old charterhouse and take the east track.

legacy.name: El Pla de Mont-ral
legacy.notes: High plateau Scots pine that fruits after the first cold rains and draws weekend pickers from Reus and Tarragona.
legacy.access: From Mont-ral follow the forest track north-east onto the plateau; park at the clearing by the cistern.

legacy.name: Pinedes del Ter (Setcases)
legacy.notes: Black-pine belt that holds dew until noon; classic mid-season stop.
legacy.access: From Setcases follow the Vallter road 4 km; park at the Font del Faig lay-by and take the track north-east above the river.

legacy.name: Costes de Malpàs
legacy.notes: Mid-season ground on stony soil that needs a good September soak before it produces.
legacy.access: From El Pont de Suert take the road up to Malpàs; park at the edge of the village and follow the track onto the north-west slopes.

legacy.name: El Solell
legacy.notes: A warmer, drier face that fruits only after good October rains and empties fast on fine weekends.
legacy.access: From La Nou de Berguedà follow the lane south-east past the last masies; park at the gate of the final enclosure.

legacy.name: Coll de Fígols
legacy.notes: A modest, south-west stand that yields in waves after each rainy spell.
legacy.access: From Fígols take the old road towards Cercs; park at the bend below the col.

legacy.name: Serrat de Gréixer
legacy.notes: A mix of Scots and black pine with good moss cover that produces after the first cold nights, usually a week behind the valleys.
legacy.access: From Gréixer village take the signed track towards the Serrat shepherds' huts; park at the closed barrier past the last barn.

legacy.name: Galliners de Ponent
legacy.notes: A few Scots pines on the shadier end keep it going a week longer than the crest.
legacy.access: From Sant Quirze del Vallès take the lane west past the last houses and continue on the dirt track to the end of the serra; park at the cistern.

legacy.name: El Sot de Moià
legacy.notes: Sheltered hollow; keeps humidity after dry spells.
legacy.access: Take the track south-west of town past the sports field; park at the stream crossing.

legacy.name: Serra de Llaberia — obaga
legacy.notes: Coastal-range pines; night humidity drifts in from the sea.
legacy.access: From the coll de Llaberia take the track to the antenna; park below the summit.

legacy.name: Pi negre de Llessui
legacy.notes: Famous black pine belt above Llessui that can be crowded on October weekends after a good rain.
legacy.access: From Sort take the mountain road to Llessui and continue to the ski station; park at the base buildings and walk into the forest below the pistes.

legacy.name: Sant Medir
legacy.notes: Families and school groups strip these slopes, though the shady draws still yield small late flushes.
legacy.access: From Barcelona take the road up from Esplugues to the Sant Medir shrine; park at the clearing by the shrine.

legacy.name: Solana d'Alòs
legacy.notes: South-facing pinewood that fruits in pulses right after rain and empties fast under local pressure.
legacy.access: From Alòs de Balaguer take the track that rises south of the village towards the serra; park at the water tank at the first bend.

legacy.name: Pinedes de Santa Linya
legacy.notes: Transitional pinewood between the plain and the serra that produces best in wet Octobers.
legacy.access: From Alòs de Balaguer take the road to Santa Linya and the dirt track behind the village; park at the entrance to the olive terraces.

legacy.name: Comaflora
legacy.notes: A high, mossy black-pine comal that holds snowmelt dampness and fruits heavily once the season turns.
legacy.access: From Gósol take the road towards Josa and then the track into the Serra del Verd; park at the foot of the Comaflora track.

legacy.name: Sant Miquel
legacy.notes: The most hammered north face in the massif — dawn starts are essential for even a small basket.
legacy.access: From Monistrol de Montserrat take the camí to the Sant Miquel hermitage; park at the road's end above the town.

legacy.name: Serra de Vespella
legacy.notes: One of the better Gaià-side pine belts; go on weekday mornings because Tarragona families sweep it in season.
legacy.access: From Vespella de Gaià take the track behind the church up onto the serra; park at the turning circle by the antennas.

legacy.name: La Mola — obaga
legacy.notes: Closest to Barcelona and heavily picked — walk past the monastery for unpicked strips.
legacy.access: From Sant Llorenç Savall take the trail to La Mola; park at the trailhead past the village and climb to the monastery saddle.

legacy.name: Serrat de Bassella
legacy.notes: Ordinary pine with light pressure, best mid-season once the valley bottom has had steady rain.
legacy.access: From Bassella take the road up to the Serrat and continue on the forest track; park at the water tank clearing.

legacy.name: Costa del Túnel
legacy.notes: Shaded and reliably damp, though the easy track means Barcelonan pickers work it hard on October weekends.
legacy.access: From Guardiola de Berguedà take the B-402 to the Gréixer turnoff and follow the forest track up beside the tunnel access road; park at the bend by the water tank.

legacy.name: La Febró Side
legacy.notes: East-facing Scots pine towards La Febró gives steady October flushes with fewer pickers than the plateau itself.
legacy.access: From La Mussara take the road towards La Febró; park at the bend by the picnic area and climb east.

legacy.name: Serrat de Sant Sadurní
legacy.notes: Open slopes above the golden villages that fruit briefly and are combed by locals each October.
legacy.access: From Forallac take the road toward Peratallada and turn onto the serrat track; park at the chapel of Sant Sadurní.

legacy.name: Les Solanelles
legacy.notes: Sun-baked upper slopes that only produce after a wet, cold spell and see almost no pickers.
legacy.access: From Gósol follow the track climbing the south-east flank of the Serra del Verd; park at the fold below the crest.

legacy.name: Obaga de Beuda
legacy.notes: Small mossy pockets on the obaga that fruit after autumn storms, with almost no pressure.
legacy.access: From Beuda take the lane north past the church; park at the barns below the village and follow the path into the north-west pines.

legacy.name: Riera de Castellet
legacy.notes: Riverside pine that only produces after very wet spells and sees constant local traffic.
legacy.access: From Sant Vicenç de Castellet take the path up the riera from the station; park at the bridge.

legacy.name: Masmolets
legacy.notes: Out-of-the-way woods where the southwest aspect means a short but rarely contested window after each rain.
legacy.access: From Valls take the TV-2442 towards Masmolets; park at the hamlet and take the track south-west up the slope.

legacy.name: Pla de Martiva north
legacy.notes: Flat accessible woods that fruit early and are swept by local families within days of a good rain.
legacy.access: From Bolvir follow the signs for Pla de Martiva on the dirt track; park at the picnic clearing and explore the pines north of the track.

legacy.name: Costa del Coll de Julià
legacy.notes: Pass-side belt that catches both sea fog and inland rain.
legacy.access: From Pradell park at the Coll de Julià pass; walk the north-east slopes below the antennas.

legacy.name: Can Caralleu
legacy.notes: Every patch near the centre is picked within hours of rain, so arrive before dawn or not at all.
legacy.access: From Barcelona take the Ronda de Dalt to the Can Caralleu exit and park at the sports centre; take the trail behind the complex uphill.

legacy.name: Solana de Montsant
legacy.notes: Big sunny faces of Scots pine that produce after the first cool storms; popular with Priorat locals, so come on weekdays.
legacy.access: From Poboleda follow the track towards the Escaladei monastery and continue to the firebreak below the cliff line; park at the water deposit.

legacy.name: Cingles de Bertí
legacy.notes: Cliff-top pines; the shade line along the cingle is the productive strip.
legacy.access: From Moià take the Sant Quirze Safaja road; park at the Bertí track fork and walk to the cliff edge.

legacy.name: Bosc de Can Febrera
legacy.notes: Dense north-facing mixed pine that holds moisture well, though the Granollers crowd knows it as well as anyone.
legacy.access: From Castellar del Vallès take the Llitera track north into the Can Febrera woods; park at the forest track barrier.

legacy.name: Coll de Pradell
legacy.notes: Quiet high ground that holds a late October crop when lower sectors have already dried out.
legacy.access: From Josa take the track towards the Coll de Pradell; park at the col and work either side.

legacy.name: Plans de Gósol
legacy.notes: Higher east-facing benches; late-season producer.
legacy.access: Forest track leaving the Gósol-Saldes road eastwards at km 2; drivable to the plans.

legacy.name: Pinedes de Sant Gervasi
legacy.notes: Remote and little-picked pinewood that rewards the extra walk in moist autumns.
legacy.access: From Tremp take the road towards Gurp and turn off at Sant Gervasi onto the dirt track behind the hamlet; park at the threshing floor.

legacy.name: Obaga de Montgrony
legacy.notes: The north wall under the Montgrony cliffs; damp moss and big rings, some company on Sundays.
legacy.access: From Gombreny follow the signs to the Montgrony sanctuary; park at the sanctuary and take the track below the cliffs.

legacy.name: Obaga d'Alàs
legacy.notes: Ordinary Scots pine on the obaga that produces steadily in wet Octobers with very light picking pressure.
legacy.access: From Alàs take the forest track behind the church towards the Cerc side; park where the track forks above the fields and walk into the obaga.

legacy.name: Solanes de Ribes
legacy.notes: Slightly further in than the Roquetes banks, but still busy on weekends whenever autumn damp settles in.
legacy.access: From Sant Pere de Ribes take the track towards the Solanes above Can Lloses; park at the quarry barrier.

legacy.name: Serra de Barberà
legacy.notes: North faces above the Conca hold the dew and rovellons appear within a week of the first good storms.
legacy.access: From Barberà de la Conca take the track that climbs the serra north of the village; park at the water tank.

legacy.name: Serrat de Catllaràs (llevant)
legacy.notes: East benches below the Catllaràs antenna; a good second lap after the obaga.
legacy.access: From Guardiola follow the La Pobla road to the Sant Jaume turn; park at the second bend and take the east track.
